msg.content:
1	# Plan
     2	
     3	## Summary
     4	
     5	Prevent InnoDB lock wait timeout errors (error 1205) during PHPUnit test bootstrapping by refactoring the framework's `TestSuiteBootstrap` class. The solution has three layers: (1) decouple system user seeding from the test bootstrap so it only verifies preconditions, (2) register a shutdown handler to roll back orphaned transactions on process termination, and (3) fix misleading database name reporting in `BaseErrorRenderer`. These changes are framework-level and automatically inherited by all consuming applications (e.g., HCP Editor).
     6	
     7	**Research:** The root cause analysis is documented in the HCP Editor's [docs/agents/research/2026-04-29-db-lock-timeout.md](../../../../../../../hcp-editor/docs/agents/research/2026-04-29-db-lock-timeout.md).
     8	
     9	## Architectural Context
    10	
    11	### Test Bootstrap Chain
    12	
    13	The PHPUnit test bootstrap follows this call chain:
    14	
    15	```
    16	tests/bootstrap.php
    17	  └─ Application_Bootstrap::bootClass(TestSuiteBootstrap::class)
    18	       └─ TestSuiteBootstrap::_boot()
    19	            ├─ configureDatabase()     ← selects the test DB
    20	            ├─ configurePaths()        ← loads test helper classes
    21	            └─ configureUsers()        ← THE PROBLEM: unconditional INSERT/UPDATE in a transaction
    22	```
    23	
    24	**Key file:** `src/classes/Application/Bootstrap/Screen/TestSuiteBootstrap.php`
    25	
    26	### The Problem
    27	
    28	`configureUsers()` wraps `InitSystemUsers` in `startTransaction()` / `commitTransaction()` on every PHPUnit invocation. This acquires row-level InnoDB locks on `known_users`. If a previous PHPUnit process was orphaned (parent killed without terminating child), its open transaction holds these locks indefinitely. All subsequent test runs block for 50 seconds and fail with error 1205.
    29	
    30	The system user data (`user_id=1`, `user_id=2`) is **static and deterministic** — hardcoded in `Application::getSystemUserData()`. Writing it on every bootstrap is unnecessary.
    31	
    32	### Existing Shutdown Handler
    33	
    34	`Bootstrap::handleShutDown()` (line ~533) fires on shutdown but only writes the request log and triggers `EVENT_SYSTEM_SHUTDOWN`. It does **not** roll back open transactions. The handler is registered via `initShutdownHandler()` during the main boot sequence.
    35	
    36	### Relevant Files
    37	
    38	| File | Role |
    39	|---|---|
    40	| `src/classes/Application/Bootstrap/Screen/TestSuiteBootstrap.php` | Test bootstrap — calls `configureUsers()` |
    41	| `src/classes/Application/Users/Users.php` | `initSystemUsers()` / `initSystemUser()` — the actual INSERT/UPDATE logic |
    42	| `src/classes/Application/Installer/Task/InitSystemUsers.php` | Installer task wrapper — calls `Users::initSystemUsers()` |
    43	| `src/classes/Application/Bootstrap/Bootstrap.php` | Main bootstrap — owns the existing shutdown handler |
    44	| `src/classes/Application/Bootstrap/BootException.php` | Exception class for bootstrap failures |
    45	| `src/classes/DBHelper/Exception/BaseErrorRenderer.php` | Error rendering — hardcodes `APP_DB_NAME` constant |
    46	| `src/classes/DBHelper/DBHelper.php` | Transaction API (`startTransaction`, `rollbackConditional`, `getSelectedDB`) |
    47	| `src/classes/Application/Application.php` | `USER_ID_SYSTEM`, `USER_ID_DUMMY`, `getSystemUserIDs()`, `getSystemUserData()` |
    48	| `tests/bootstrap.php` | Framework's own test bootstrapper |
    49	| `tests/sql/testsuite.sql` | Test DB schema (~1,291 lines) |
    50	
    51	### Key Observations from Source
    52	
    53	**`TestSuiteBootstrap::configureUsers()` (current):**
    54	```php
    55	private function configureUsers(): void
    56	{
    57	    DBHelper::startTransaction();
    58	    Application::createInstaller()->getTaskByID('InitSystemUsers')->process();
    59	    DBHelper::commitTransaction();
    60	}
    61	```
    62	- No `try/catch` — if `process()` throws, the transaction stays open.
    63	- No rollback path at all.
    64	
    65	**`Users::initSystemUser()` (called by the task):**
    66	- Calls `DBHelper::requireTransaction()` — mandates an active transaction.
    67	- If user exists → updates all fields and saves (acquires row lock).
    68	- If user doesn't exist → inserts.
    69	- Data is deterministic — the UPDATE is always a no-op in practice.
    70	
    71	**`DBHelper::rollbackConditional()`:**
    72	- Rolls back only if a transaction is active (no-op otherwise).
    73	- Safe to call in shutdown handlers — will not throw.
    74	
    75	**`DBHelper::getSelectedDB()`:**
    76	- Returns `array{name, username, password, host, port}` for the currently selected DB.
    77	- Throws `DBHelper_Exception` if no DB is selected.
    78	
    79	**`BaseErrorRenderer` constructor (line 36):**
    80	```php
    81	$this->line('Database: '.APP_DB_USER . '@' .APP_DB_NAME . ' on '.APP_DB_HOST);
    82	```
    83	- Uses boot-time constants, not the currently selected DB.
    84	- Misleading when the test DB is active — shows the main DB name.
    85	
    86	## Approach / Architecture
    87	
    88	### Layer 1: Decouple Seeding from Bootstrap
    89	
    90	**Principle:** Tests should assert preconditions, not establish infrastructure.
    91	
    92	- **`configureUsers()`** becomes verify-only: checks that system users exist via `SELECT` (non-locking read) and throws `BootException` if any are missing, with a message directing the developer to run `composer seed-tests`.
    93	- **New public static method `seedSystemUsers()`** encapsulates the seeding logic (the current `configureUsers()` body). It wraps the transaction in try/catch with rollback-on-failure. This is callable from setup scripts in the framework and consuming applications.
    94	- **New `tests/seed-test-db.php`** script provides the `composer seed-tests` entry point.
    95	
    96	### Layer 2: Shutdown Handler for Transaction Cleanup
    97	
    98	- A new private method `registerTransactionCleanupHandler()` calls `register_shutdown_function` with a static closure that invokes `DBHelper::rollbackConditional()`.
    99	- Called in `_boot()` after `configureDatabase()`.
   100	- Fires on fatal errors, uncaught exceptions, OOM, and normal exit — everything except `SIGKILL`.
